description: Encuentra series del INE y presenta sus cifras con periodo, unidad, definición y límites de comparación.

defaultPrompt: Find the current INE series for my question, with its units and latest observation date.
Compare these official Spanish statistics without mixing bases or periods.
interface.longDescription:
Find INE tables and series and calculate traceable changes while preserving units, dates and missing values.

Use bounded read-only official-source queries, a clearly dated offline example, and source-linked Markdown, HTML or JSON reports. Review returned dates, identifiers, provenance, errors and unexamined coverage before acting. No official affiliation, eligibility, legal, title, solvency or reuse-rights certification is claimed.

Runs a bundled local stdio MCP on compatible desktop hosts with Python 3.11+ and authorized network access. No API key, account, dependency installation, hosted publisher service, telemetry or purchase functionality is provided. Reports return text without writing files. An unavailable local server is disclosed; scripts are never an execution fallback. This package does not create a web/mobile remote connection.

prompts: Encuentra la serie adecuada para comparar el IPC y explica su base y periodo.
Comprueba si esta serie sigue actualizada antes de llamarla el dato más reciente.
Presenta estos datos sin convertir nulos o valores confidenciales en cero.

positive.description: Core workflow. Supply the concrete identifiers/dates requested by the skill. Verify source facts, coverage and a practical next step; no success is assumed if a provider fails.
positive.prompt: Compara las cinco últimas observaciones de la serie IPC251852, conservando unidades, base, fechas y valores ausentes.
positive.expected_behavior: Use ine_series_change with {"series_code": "IPC251852", "last": 5}. Preserve actual returned dates, identifiers, sources and coverage. Treat provider failure or partial retrieval as unverified scope, never a fabricated complete result.

positive.description: Independent source detail or bounded search variation. Validate identifiers and requested dates before querying.
positive.prompt: Muestra las dos últimas observaciones de la serie IPC251852 con sus fechas y unidades.
positive.expected_behavior: Use ine_series with {"series_code": "IPC251852", "last": 2}. Preserve actual returned dates, identifiers, sources and coverage. Treat provider failure or partial retrieval as unverified scope, never a fabricated complete result.

positive.description: Offline historical example. Network must remain unused.

positive.expected_behavior: Call ine_evidence_demo with no arguments. Show example.live=false, captured_at and retained source links. Explicitly call the result historical, never current.

positive.prompt: Turn that saved example into a readable HTML report, preserving its date, sources and limitations. Do not save a file.
positive.expected_behavior: Call ine_evidence_report with operation=ine_evidence_demo and format=html. Return the report text. Preserve the historical marker and errors/coverage; include no scripts or external report assets and make no file write.

es-ES.subtitle: Estadísticas con contexto
es-ES.description:
Encuentra series del INE y presenta sus cifras con periodo, unidad, definición y límites de comparación.

Analistas, periodistas, docentes y consultoras. Descubre operaciones, tablas y series sin inventar códigos. Conserva los resultados dentro de cada página. Distingue periodo observado de fecha de consulta.

Ejemplos guardados sin conexión e informes HTML/Markdown/JSON. Sin cuenta adicional, claves API ni servicio propio. Los anfitriones de escritorio compatibles invocan los adaptadores mediante el MCP local declarado (Python 3.11+ y red autorizada). Los anfitriones sin MCP local utilizan solo sus herramientas nativas autorizadas, sin ejecutar scripts como alternativa.

No ofrece previsiones ni asesoramiento de inversión. Una serie disponible puede estar discontinuada o usar una base antigua. No une series incompatibles ni infiere actualidad por disponibilidad.
